roles.holdoutCustodian: Owns encrypted prompts, graders, repositories, reference solutions and the append-only access log outside the candidate-author environment.
roles.candidateAuthor: May read this public boundary and digest-only readiness receipt, but no private prompt, grader or repository locator before RC freeze.
roles.benchmarkOperator: May invoke a custodian-provided execute-only interface against an exact frozen candidate and receives only redacted outcome evidence.
roles.humanReviewer: Receives a blinded task/output/rubric packet, records an independent first score and cannot see product surface labels.
roles.adjudicator: Resolves sealed disagreements after both first-pass scores exist and must be independent of candidate authors.
roles.releaseAuditor: Verifies the sealed artifacts in the controlled environment and exports only the closed v2 assurance receipt.

privateArtifactClasses: reviewer identities and raw score sheets
freezeRule: Custodian access receipts must predate the first private execution and remain valid through the exact RC run; any candidate, suite, grader, rubric, access-policy or evidence change invalidates comparability.
claimBoundary: This policy establishes a fail-closed custody contract only. It contains no private holdout and grants no generalization, quality, token, latency or release claim.
